slides.title: Myth: guests need a spotless house. Truth: they only see 4 spots.
The front door
slides.body: Clear the shoes, wipe the handle, add a light. First impressions happen in 3 seconds.

slides.title: The bathroom sink
slides.body: Clear counter, fresh hand towel, roll of toilet paper in sight. That's the whole bathroom to a guest.

slides.title: Where people sit
slides.body: Fold the blankets, move the laundry. A clear couch says 'come in.'

slides.title: The kitchen counter
slides.body: Wipe one long stretch. Clutter in a basket, basket in a cupboard. Done.

slides.title: A guest-ready house is not a perfect house. It's four clear spots and a warm hello.
Want the 7-day version for your whole home?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
